title.zh: 能源节约（罪行构成）条例 2013
title.vi: Quy chế Tiết kiệm năng lượng (Hòa giải tội phạm) 2013
title.th: ข้อบังคับการอนุรักษ์พลังงาน (การประนีประนอมความผิด) 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Energy Conservation (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2013 and shall come into operation on 22nd April 2013.

2. The following offences may be compounded by the Director-General, or any officer of the Agency authorised by the Director-General, in accordance with section 74 of the Act:
(a)any offence (other than a continuing offence) under section 12(2), 12A(2), 18(3), 19(2), 20(a), 23(4), 23A(4), 26(2), 26A(3), 26B(4), 27(2), 27A(2), 27B(2), 28(3), 29(3), 30(5), 31A(3), 35(5), 36(2)(a), 64(3) or 65(3) of the Act;
[S 751/2017 wef 01/01/2018]
[S 721/2025 wef 01/12/2025]
(b)any offence under regulation 8D(4), 8E(4), 8F(3) or (4), 10(2), 11(2) or 12B(1), (2) or (5) of the Energy Conservation (Regulated Goods and Registered Suppliers) Regulations 2017 (G.N. No. S 748/2017).
[S 751/2017 wef 01/01/2018]
[S 384/2026 wef 01/07/2026]
[S 558/2013 wef 01/09/2013]
